COST: 128

All six adults are rescued, so there are no deferral penalties. The Benighat farm road from Naukunda is blocked, so the car must go through Likhu school. Two round trips to Naukunda are needed because the car holds only four people, and the second trip includes the Benighat detour. This route is the minimum possible: 42 minutes for the first round trip plus 86 for the second, which covers the 44-minute Benighat detour.
